summary: Wu et al. fabricated five Ti3C2Tx-based freestanding films: a pristine Ti3C2Tx nanosheet film, RAMX films containing 25%, 50%, or 75% Ti3C2Tx microgels, and a fully microgel-derived film. Ti3C2Tx was selectively etched from Ti3AlC2 using LiF/HCl, while microgels were obtained by probe-sonicating a GO-assisted Ti3C2Tx hydrogel and then vacuum-filtering mixtures with nanosheets. RAMX-50% was the headline electrode, reaching 978 F cm−3 at 10 mV s−1 in 3 M H2SO4 and 736 F cm−3 at 2000 mV s−1. The text does not print individual numerical capacitances, mass loadings, thicknesses, SSA values, or d-spacings for the other four electrodes.
